parts:
Here’s a polished, elevated post that still feels like *you*:

---

First night out since surgery… and wow, what a moment 🥹✨

Walking into entity["restaurant","Aba","Nashville, TN, USA"] tonight felt like stepping back into *life* again. The energy, the ambiance, the swanky vibe… it was everything. But what made it unforgettable wasn’t just the setting… it was who I was with.

My best friend.  
My protector.  
My confidant.  
My adventure partner.  
The man I prayed for and didn’t even fully realize I deserved.

This year has already held so much. Healing. Growth. Letting go. Rebuilding. And tonight was one of those moments where everything just clicked… like God gently whispering, “See? I’ve got you.”

Because somehow, through everything I’ve walked through the past few years, I still get to smile like this. I still get to *shine*. I still get to feel joy, love, and deep gratitude.

And that right there… that’s everything.

I love this life. I love where I am. I love who I’m becoming. And I love Tennessee for being the place where it all started coming back together 🤍

God’s timing is never wrong. Not once.

✨ Here’s to healing, happiness, and nights that remind you just how far you’ve come.

Make me a pat about going out on the town for the first time since my major surgery with the man of dreams. My best friend, my protector, my confident, my adventure buddy. Talk about how swanky Aba in Nashville was and how everything that has happened this years so far keeps reminding me of how good God is and everything works out the way it should and I love my life and ability to still shien and be happy and be grateful even though so much has happened to me in the past few years. I love TN and the way things are all going toghether
